context: A teen apologizes for not returning a borrowed item
purpose: Teach: まずい/済む/貼り/カタログ/デート/ガソリン/返す/願う

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: めいちゃん、本当にごめん。借りたカタログ、返すの忘れてた。
lines.en: Mei, I'm really sorry. I forgot to return the catalog I borrowed.
lines.style: Apologetic teen voice, hesitant and visibly embarrassed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ああ、あの春のインテリアカタログね。新居のレイアウト考えるのに使いたかったから、ちょっと困ってたんだ。
lines.en: Ah, that spring interior catalog. I wanted to use it to plan the layout for my new place, so I was a little troubled.
lines.style: Soft romantic tone, gentle but slightly disappointed and pensive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ、それはまずい…。気に入ってたページに付箋まで貼りっぱなしだったよね、本当にごめん。
lines.en: Oh no, that's bad... You'd even left sticky notes on the pages you liked, didn't you. I'm really sorry.
lines.style: Flustered teenage voice, regretful and sincere with genuine guilt.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ううん、大丈夫だよ。ちゃんと戻ってくれば、それで済む話だから。
lines.en: No, it's okay. As long as it comes back safely, that settles the matter.
lines.style: Warm forgiving tone, soft and reassuring with quiet patience.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お詫びに、今度のドライブデートはガソリン代こっち持つから許して?
lines.en: As an apology, I'll cover the gas money on our next drive date, so will you forgive me?
lines.style: Eager teenage voice, trying earnestly to make amends.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ふふ、それいいね。じゃあ明日こそ、ちゃんとカタログ返すって信じていい?
lines.en: Hehe, that sounds nice. Then can I trust that you'll properly return the catalog tomorrow?
lines.style: Playful romantic tone, teasing yet affectionate and warm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、絶対!明日の朝、家まで届けるって約束する。二度と忘れないって願うくらい本気だよ。
lines.en: Yeah, absolutely! I promise I'll bring it to your house tomorrow morning. I'm so serious I'm wishing I'll never forget again.
lines.style: Determined teen voice, earnest and slightly dramatic with conviction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: じゃあ、それで全部チャラってことにしよう。仲直りのデートも兼ねてね。
lines.en: Alright, let's call it all even with that. We'll make it a make-up date too.
lines.style: Soft romantic close, warm and forgiving with an affectionate smile.
